questions.question: At which ground did Limpopo Lillies record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — highest total of 136, against Knights on 2025/11/02.

questions.question: At Willowmoore Park Main Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
At which ground did Rhinos record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 46, against Limpopo Lillies on 2019/02/03.

questions.question: At which ground did Michelle Schoeman record their career-best bowling figures (2-19, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2022/02/05.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Limpopo Lillies or Tuskers?
Which of these players was born in South Africa and went on to represent another country internationally, but never represented a South African provincial team?
questions.explanation: Scholfield was born in Amanzimtoti and made her debut for England in September 2024.
